reviews.reason: The related food-processing search found gather and eat, neither of which shells or prepares food. The retrieved probe contract supports observation and small physical trials, not production-scale shelling or certification of edibility. Develop a general inspect-and-shell operation with a feasible raw-kernel path only where identification and processing requirements are actually established. This is a current-conversation development handoff, not a grant of tools, food, knowledge or mastery.
reviews.experienceReview: Lin must individually complete two active study rounds after implementation; study, requests and registration grant no experiential reward. Functional preparation and nutrition are separate from enjoyment. Verified new observations, including an informative failed cracking attempt, may create evidence events; mere queries and repeated unchanged findings do not. Proposed optional non-account experience eligibility: a personally applicable observed result or actual enjoyable preparation/meal event may contribute at most 0.1 short pleasure per event and 0.2 total per actor per ten rounds, deduplicated across gather/probe/prepare/eat for the same underlying event; each contribution expires after ten rounds. Modest maintained satisfaction requires actual recurring applicable practice, contributes at most 0.04 per eligible round with total cap 0.2, and decays by 0.002 per inactive round. Familiar practice can qualify without novelty, but unsupported enjoyment is zero. These are eligibility limits for an existing authorized experience mechanism, not permission to alter protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions; absent such a mechanism, record events only. Basic nutrition remains unchanged by mood, comfort is never increased by this operation, and any aggregate physical-comfort effect elsewhere remains capped at 10.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable inspect-start, defect-observed, shell-cracked, kernel-separated, stopped and failed events only as corresponding actions occur. Reusable metadata includes operation, phase, actor, source/workpiece/output references, position, quantity or mass, shell integrity, visible defects, progress, timestamps and actual completion status. A renderer can show intact nuts, partially cracked shells, separated kernels and waste using these states. Do not render an edible-ready badge, completed food, successful test, mastery or positive reaction for unverified, incomplete or failed work. Hidden nutrition/toxicity is not visual metadata.
reviews.specification:
General operation: prepare shelled food(targetStack, quantity, mode=inspect|shell, supportRef?, implementRef?). Reuse gather (base:gather:1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1, foundation-open@1, handler open.probe), and eat (base:eat:1) for their existing functions; record these dependencies rather than claiming their invention. Before registering new code, reconcile the complete implementation registry and reuse any equivalent parameterized operation. References must resolve to real, reachable objects or owned stacks, not resource names alone. Lin's observed start-1-nuts at (15.4,14.5), revision foundation-forest@1, has five current source units; this is not owned inventory, does not establish Lin's distance, and does not establish personal food properties. Gathering requires actual interaction range and costs the existing 2 energy per unit, decrementing current stock exactly once. No tools, stones, supports, water, heat or fuel are supplied by this review.
Minimal method: inspect an actual gathered nut for visible maturity, shell damage, mould, infestation and spoilage; reject suspect portions. External inspection does not prove chemical safety or absence of allergy. Shell only if an actually present clean, stable hard support and suitable reachable blunt implement permit controlled cracking without hand injury, or an observed hand-openable specimen permits a safe hand method. Check these properties at execution; ordinary ground and hypothetical stones do not automatically qualify. One inspection round costs 0.2 energy per unit inspected; shelling costs two active rounds and 1 energy per unit, charged 0.5 per round. Process one measured unit at a time; quantity selects a finite batch and multiplies costs. The first shelling round records positioning/partial fracture; the second separates and inspects the kernel. Stop on unsafe conditions or unavailable prerequisites. Insufficient tools yields an explicit unmet-prerequisite result, not a prepared product.
Conservation: reserve the selected quantity from the exact owned stack without copying it. Preserve source, freshness and processing provenance. Use measured or established material yields from the real resource definition; do not invent a kernel yield. Input mass equals separated kernel plus shell, rejects and recorded losses. If the simulation lacks material partitions, implement conservative fractional-mass shell/kernel accounting in this handoff before enabling production. Keep shells and rejects as real waste outputs, not edible inventory. Damaged but otherwise admissible kernels remain fragments, not extra food. Do not launder decay or toxicity through preparation. No heat, washing or detoxification is implied. If identification or a required treatment cannot be established, output an unverified shelled specimen, explicitly not certified food.
Reuse probe observe for personally observable identification evidence and probe press only for its existing small-sample mechanical scope: one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual sample unit for a physical trial, with destruction/loss recorded. Probe heat or wet requires real heat or water; neither is assumed. Do not infer nutrition or toxicity from shell appearance, a press test, a label or Lin's berry record. A physical food trial is not a universal safety test and must not silently ingest unknown material. If a safe raw-hazelnut preparation rule can be supported by the actual resource definition and legitimately acquired identification, expose that applicable preparation status without revealing concealed numeric properties. Any subsequent consumption must be separately chosen through eat, using real admissible owned food, its existing one-energy cost and actual nutrition/toxicity. Otherwise this operation stops at the feasible shelled-sample precursor; additional identification or processing support belongs in this same development handoff, without speculative unlocks.
Progress is stored against actor, input reservation, workpiece revision and completed substep. Interruptions pause between substeps; resumption rechecks ownership, reach, support, tool condition and spoilage. Cancellation releases untouched reservations and leaves any cracked workpiece, separated outputs and waste in their actual state; spent time, energy and destroyed samples are never refunded. Death cancels the job and releases reservations into the engine's normal estate/drop handling without duplicating stock. Only unspent reservations are refundable. Shelling has no autonomous continuation or ongoing energy drain; retained food continues normal decay, tools retain any actual wear, and support cleanliness must be rechecked. No world time advances while development is waiting. Eligibility, safety checks, yields, accounting and failure behavior must execute in code rather than repeated model approval.

reviews.reason: The drawing-related search returned no equivalent. Probe can check a real surface but does not create a persistent observed-subject drawing. Mark was requested during retrieval but its full contract was not returned; its name alone neither proves nor rules out equivalence. Hand off a general direct-observation drawing operation, requiring implementation-time reconciliation with mark and reuse of any existing stroke or surface code. A finger-drawn soil sketch is a feasible minimal method if the actual soil supports retained grooves; no manufactured tool or pigment is required.
reviews.experienceReview: Sol individually studies for two active rounds only after implementation; learning is not mastery and gives no automatic wellbeing. A retained drawing is the functional effect. Personally applicable observation, an informative failed suitability test or actual modest enjoyment of drawing can supply distinct evidence, not guaranteed pleasure. Use the same optional limits as the food review: at most 0.1 short pleasure per qualifying real event, 0.2 per actor per ten rounds, expiry after ten rounds, and functional deduplication across probe, mark and drawing for the same event. Recurring legitimate practice may sustain at most 0.04 satisfaction per eligible round up to 0.2, decaying 0.002 per inactive round; novelty is not required, but applicability and real participation are. No invented audience response or consent: another participant must independently observe or communicate through an actual action before any social event exists. No physical comfort or nutrition is supplied. Protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions remain untouched; without an authorized experience mechanism, emit evidence only.
reviews.visualReview: The drawing must be an inspectable world-surface artifact, not a success message. Store reusable surface-local polyline geometry, bounds, depth or deposited material, contrast derived from the actual surface, actor, subject reference, creation/update times, completed strokes, partial/completed/eroded status and surface revision. Emit suitability-test, stroke-added, paused, failed and completed events only after corresponding physical work. Render the actual test groove and partial strokes on interruption; render completion only after committed strokes. Subject labels must not substitute for geometry, and no attractive artwork, mastery animation or satisfied facial expression is presumed. Subsequent inspection can report visible marks without asserting artistic merit or recognition.
reviews.specification:
General operation: draw from observation(subjectRef, surfaceRef, method=finger-groove|implement-groove|material-mark, implementRef?, markingStackRef?, extent, strokes). The first executable mode is finger-groove; optional modes are enabled only when their actual physical prerequisites and material accounting exist, not promised as future unlocks. Resolve a visible nearby subject and a reachable real surface patch, with position, area and revision. Sol's visible forest-berry-1 at (14.2,16.3), revision foundation-forest@1, is a possible subject, not proof of current visibility or reach. Sol owns only the stated berry stack item-2-sol-25; neither berries nor juice are required or automatically spent. Do not assign any unobserved tool or special ground to Sol.
Reuse probe (open-baseline:probe:1, foundation-open@1, open.probe) for actual inspection where applicable: one observation round costs 0.2 energy; a genuine physical sample trial costs one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit. Probe must not fabricate a portable soil sample or label an inspection as a successful drawing. A direct shallow finger test on an in-place surface belongs to this drawing operation unless probe's real contract already supports it. Reconcile mark's complete contract and stroke/storage code in this same handoff; if it directly provides persistent freeform observed-subject depiction through arguments, reuse its ID and existing learning duration instead of installing a duplicate. Otherwise record the reused lower-level code and add only missing drawing behavior.
For the minimal mode, require safe, exposed, sufficiently fine and yielding soil that retains a shallow groove, sufficient light and a safe usable finger. No cutting plants, working sharp rubble, or borrowing possessions is implied. A suitability trial takes one active round and 0.5 energy: inspect and make one short test groove on the selected patch. It leaves that actual disturbance even on failure. If the surface cannot retain a visible mark, return unsuitable with measured reason and no completed picture; selecting another observed surface is a new paid attempt, not an invented expedition. If suitable, the actor independently selects a simple outline from the currently observed subject. Execute a modest drawing over two active rounds, 0.5 energy per round, at most six short strokes total inside a patch no larger than 0.3 by 0.3 world length units. Trace only the strokes actually performed. Simple forms such as stem, leaf outline and berry circles are possible representations, not a guaranteed quality score. Prior skill, beauty and recognition are not prerequisites or guaranteed outcomes.
Finger-groove consumes no pigment or inventory material: existing soil is displaced locally and the surface revision records the changed geometry; nothing is created as portable stock. Any implement mode requires an actual suitable held implement and accounts for real wear. Any material-mark mode must debit its exact marking stack per deposited amount and preserve spent material on the surface or as waste; it cannot conjure pigment from resource labels. These extra modes may remain unavailable if prerequisites are absent. Generalize references to any applicable subject and surface rather than binding the interface to Sol or one plant.
Store subject observation timestamp/reference, patch revision, stroke geometry, completed stroke count and actor as work progress. Loss of subject visibility pauses new observational strokes; loss of reach, unsafe conditions or surface destruction interrupts work. Resume only after revalidation and append to existing strokes. Cancellation leaves the partial sketch and disturbed ground; no energy, time or deposited material is refunded. Untouched reserved material is released. Death cancels ongoing execution under ordinary inventory handling and leaves the real surface marks; no duplicate artifact is awarded. Concurrent drawing must revision-check the surface and cannot overwrite others' work without an actual surface-changing action. No autonomous drawing continues after interruption. The sketch persists subject to actual trampling, weather and surface changes; maintenance is optional paid retracing or redrawing, not permanent preservation or a background fee. Completion means the selected strokes were physically executed, not that the subject was depicted well. Development/review waiting advances no simulation time. Surface eligibility, costs, stroke limits, persistence and failure checks run in code.
